figures.title: Continuous Sample Space Square Diagram
figures.description: A unit square drawn on a two-dimensional Cartesian plane representing the set Ω = {(x, y) | 0 ≤ x, y ≤ 1}. The horizontal axis is labeled 'x' with the mark '1' at the bottom-right corner of the square. The vertical axis is labeled 'y' with the mark '1' at the top-left corner of the square. The diagram illustrates a continuous two-dimensional sample space bounded between 0 and 1 along both axes.
